# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Commit Messages

For every git commit unless explicitly asked otherwise:

- Use Conventional Commits format (`type(scope): 简短说明`).
- Write title and body in Chinese.
- Split title and body with exactly one blank line.
- Body uses real newlines and `- ` bullets; never write literal `\n`.
- Keep the title concise and focused.
- Prefer 2-4 body bullets.

### Required Shape:

type(scope): 中文标题

- 要点 1
- 要点 2
- 要点 3
